Scope and uncertainty

Historical October 2024 deployment snapshot: NVIDIA reported 100,000 Hopper GPUs in Memphis. This is not a current live inventory. Node count, CPUs, per-node accelerator count and memory are not verified here.

Not verified means a detail has not been confirmed in this catalog. Diagrams are schematic; node indices are illustrative, not physical hostnames. Data checked 14 September 2026.
